risk_note: RV2 ledger + settlement (B2-02t; FU-CREDIT-POSTCHECK-5MIN, BR-FUND-19 last sentence; D10-1035 / D10-1038 / D10-1052 / D10-1065). After R5 / R5a post a beneficiary credit voucher, the same transaction enqueues ledger-credit-postcheck with the base and net-before of that moment; the handler recomputes the share independently (floor(base × ratio_bp / 10000) − net_before, BR-CALC-04, no planInitialCredit) from the immutable attribution and compares it with the voucher's entry. A difference registers a ledger_mismatch recon diff (R3, unique dedupe key), holds that user's withdrawals (forfeit vouchers: diff and alert only, no hold) and alerts as the last step of the transaction; closing the diff releases the hold (existing). Switch ledger.credit_postcheck.enabled, unset = on. No migration, no contract.
